summary: Tested WhatsApp-style hold-to-record voice notes in Admin Live Chat (Tim Admin channel). Backend attachment endpoint regression (test_admin_live_chat_attachment.py) 9/9 passed. Frontend UI: logged in as Admin Provinsi, verified live-chat-record-button exists and no 'Balasan saya' text is rendered. Stubbed MediaRecorder/getUserMedia to simulate real recording, then validated: (1) pointerdown shows live-chat-recording-status with unlocked copy ('Merekam — lepas untuk kirim...'), pointerup without vertical drag auto-sends a voice note (new live-chat-audio-<id> control appears); (2) pointerdown + pointermove 80px upward switches status to locked copy ('Rekaman dikunci — tekan tombol untuk kirim'), pointerup does NOT stop recording, subsequent click on the mic button sends the voice note (audio count increments); (3) plain text message send still works; (4) document (PDF) attachment upload via live-chat-attachment-input still works. Cleaned 5 test-created message docs from admin_live_chat_messages (3 voice-note webm + 1 text + 1 PDF).
critical_code_review_comments: LiveChat.jsx still contains the legacy toggleRecording() function (lines ~96-114) which is unused now that onPointerDown/Up/Move + onClick handle the press-to-record flow. Safe to remove to reduce dead code.

startPressRecording relies on native PointerEvent.clientY from onPointerDown/Move; on touch devices without pointer events this will silently fall back to unlocked mode. Consider adding onTouchStart/onTouchMove parity or verifying Pointer Events polyfill coverage for target browsers.
If getUserMedia is denied the toast fires but the button remains 'Tahan untuk rekam'; consider surfacing a persistent hint so admins understand mic permission must be granted at the browser level.

sendVoiceNote sends message='' – ensure backend/UI list rendering of empty message strings stays visually clean (currently renders empty

, fine but a small visual gap remains). Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Removed 5 admin_live_chat_messages created during this run (3 voice notes with voice-note-*.webm filenames, 1 text 'TEST_iter52 text voice-note e2e', 1 PDF TEST_iter52_doc.pdf). Physical attachment blobs on disk may remain unreachable per storage limitation as noted in the task.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice-note flow relies on MediaRecorder + PointerEvents. In headless Playwright the browser does not have a real mic; stub navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia and MediaRecorder (see iteration_52 script) before dispatching pointerdown/pointermove/pointerup/click events directly on [data-testid=live-chat-record-button]. Vertical lock threshold is 48px (moves upward). Backend endpoint POST /api/admin/live-chat/messages/attachment is the shared path for voice notes and document uploads; regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_live_chat_attachment.py.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature works as specified: press-and-hold records, release auto-sends, slide up locks, click on locked mic sends. No 'Balasan saya' text present anywhere in LiveChat.jsx.
